name: Shenzhen Changhong Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Changhong Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides precision mold design and manufacturing solutions in China and internationally. The company offers medical devices and polymer plastic consumables; intelligent manufacturing products; semiconductor consumables, including semiconductor wafer carriers and cleanroom packaging materials; and mold products. It also engages in investment, and research and development activities. The company was formerly known as Shenzhen Changhong Mold Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shenzhen Changhong Technology Co., Ltd. in May 2012.
